text:
Lina: Heads-up — changelog cutoff is tomorrow 18:00 PT. We need owners for any docs, SDK, quickstart, and sampleapp changes that must land before freeze. Reply with what you own or if you are blocking.
Sam: I can own the SDK changelog and release notes. PRs #432 and #435 are targeting `release/v1.4`. Expect to have changelog excerpts by EOD.
Priya: I’ll take quickstarts + sampleapps. Noted a failing CI job on sampleapp-node — looking into it: https://ci.example/builds/12345
Marta: I’ll triage docs PR queue. Need a dev review for API surface change in #439 (small param rename). If no dev review fast, I can at least polish the docs text.
docs-bot: changelog-preview generated: PRs [#432,#435,#439]. Conflict detected: `sampleapp/README.md` (auto-merge failed).
Kai: quick question for eng-release — any breaking API changes we should call out loudly?
Jared: From release side: no breaking changes. One param alias in sdk-go (`temperature` -> `temp`) but we preserved alias compatibility. I’ll add a short note in the release brief.
Lina: Perfect. Action items: Sam -> SDK changelog+merge plan; Priya -> sampleapp fix or mitigation; Marta -> docs triage + review #439; Jared -> add release note about alias. Freeze requested at 17:30 PT (earlier than public cutoff) so we have 30m buffer before 18:00.
Priya: Investigating CI failure now. Root cause looks like a race in the local test DB init. If I can't get a clean green by 16:30 PT I’ll submit a hotfix PR that skips the flaky test and link it here. Assigning @devops for help with test infra.
devops: Got the assignment, scaling up ephemeral DBs for sampleapp CI. Will post logs once done.
Marta: Starting review of #439 — will comment inline in ~45m. If I need implementation changes I’ll mark them as post-freeze unless they block docs correctness.
Sam: I’ll prepare the release PR and include the changelog snippet. @Lina please confirm freeze at 17:30 and I’ll hold merges until you give the go. The merge command I’ll use is: `git checkout release/v1.4 && ./scripts/generate_changelog.sh && git push origin release/v1.4`
Lina: Freeze confirmed at 17:30 PT. If anything truly blocking appears after that, DM me and we’ll triage. Otherwise non-blocking follow-ups can land in patch after the release. :thumbsup:
Kai: Adding a short compatibility note to the console docs about sampleapp nodes; small copy edit inbound.
Priya: Update: created hotfix PR #441 that skips flaky test as fallback. Will revert after infra stabilizes. Link: https://git.example/pr/441
Marta: Reviewed #439 — small wording nits and one place where the code sample needs updated param name. Marked for dev reviewer @Jared.
Jared: I’ll take the dev review on #439 this afternoon. Expected time ~30-40m.
Sam: Thanks everyone — will queue the release and not merge until Lina gives the final thumbs up after the 17:30 freeze window.
Lina: Thank you all. Quick checklist: SDK changelog (Sam) ✅, docs triage (Marta) ✅ (pending dev review), sampleapp mitigation PR (Priya) ✅, release notes (Jared) ✅. If no other blockers by 17:25 PT we proceed with merge at 17:30.
Priya: Copy — monitoring CI now.
Kai: Noted and standing by to patch console copy post-merge.
Lina: If anything else pops, ping here or DM. Thanks!
Sam: +1
Marta: +1
Priya: +1
Jared: +1
